battle_phases.completion_condition: All opening runners are killed or securely intercepted, Ansel is deployed, and Spot receives lower-central duty at 1651.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An opening death, leak or lost grant removes the economic and interception basis of every later replacement.
battle_phases.goal: Survive four opening routes with shared damage and establish first medicine.
handoff_requirements: Activate Vanilla at 1650 before her living retreat.
Retreat Vanilla and deploy Spot on the same tile at 1651.
responsibilities: Midnight supports Fang while retaining upper-outer interception.
Vanilla generates two grants before Spot replaces her.
Melantha intercepts the lower-outer runner and advances eastern restraint destruction.
Ansel restores the central opening survivors.
survival_dependencies: Midnight's early damage must replace the removed Lancet contribution.
Fang and Vanilla must survive their credited grants.
Melantha must retain enough HP for the first artillery impact.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Eastern lower restraint is destroyed, Beagle and both medics are alive, eastern Steward is attacking, and returning Vanilla precedes lower-outer officer contact.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A surviving eastern restraint, missing medic or late outer bridge exposes civilians and invalidates the planned redeployments.
battle_phases.goal: Complete eastern clearance and establish permanent blockers, reciprocal medicine and artillery damage.
handoff_requirements: Fang's third grant precedes his 2072 withdrawal.
Beagle replaces Fang at the same frame.
Vanilla's first return respects the full cooldown and reaches [6,3] before interception is required.
responsibilities: Melantha finishes roadblock #4 before withdrawing at 2040.
Fang supplies his third grant before Beagle replaces him.
Ansel boosts early shell recovery; Hibiscus completes reciprocal coverage.
Midnight finishes roadblock #3 and saves his arts activation for the later officer pair.
Steward supplies dedicated artillery damage.
survival_dependencies: Opening Melantha's clearance and living withdrawal are jointly necessary.
Ansel must survive initial exposure before reciprocal healing begins.
Both medics must deliver sufficient healing without assumed recipient ordering.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Artillery is dead before 4680, pending impacts are survived, returning Melantha holds the lower outer lane and Fang covers the upper outer lane.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An unresolved artillery threat, surviving officer from an abandoned lane or failed caster deployment defeats the final-wave structure.
battle_phases.goal: Close artillery while transferring both outer corridors and establishing central arts.
handoff_requirements: Midnight withdraws only after his assigned pair is closed.
Fang and Melantha returns satisfy their cooldowns.
Steward's fixed withdrawal requires previously observed artillery death.
responsibilities: Steward retains artillery responsibility until actual death.
Hibiscus and Ansel overlap boosts during eastern caster exposure.
Lava damages central officers and armor with single-target arts.
Midnight's first officer pair must die before his 4110 withdrawal.
Melantha receives Vanilla's queue and begins western lower clearance.
battle_phases.start_condition: Lava deploys at 3810 with both central blockers alive.
survival_dependencies: Vanilla must survive until the 4173 replacement.
Both eastern casters must survive repeated impacts.
Lava's central targeting cannot be counted simultaneously as guaranteed artillery damage.

battle_phases.completion_condition: The final spawn has occurred, Midnight and fresh Vanilla receive the outer lanes, and Steward returns to upper-central arts at 6781.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A saturated central blocker or failed outer bridge permits a leak before the final formation can complete clearance.
battle_phases.goal: Intercept every final spawn without central block saturation or outer bridge collapse.
handoff_requirements: Retreat Fang immediately before deploying Midnight at 6211.
Retreat Melantha immediately before deploying Vanilla at 6330.
Steward's return follows more than 2100 frames off field.
responsibilities: Lava clears older central pressure sufficiently to leave capacity for later runners and armor.
Both medics sustain the simultaneous central queues.
Melantha destroys western lower roadblock #2 and uses her boost against final officers.
Fang bridges upper officers until Midnight returns.
Fresh Vanilla receives the final lower-outer officer.
battle_phases.start_condition: Eastern Steward withdraws at 4680 after artillery closure.
survival_dependencies: Fang must remain alive through the 6211 same-tile handoff.
Earlier armor must actually die before block capacity is exhausted.
Melantha must remain alive through her planned withdrawal.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Remaining life is positive, zero enemies leaked, spawns are exhausted, no active enemies remain, both protected targets arrived and neither died.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Any leak, protected death, missing protected arrival or surviving enemy rejects full-stage acceptance.
battle_phases.goal: Finish every hostile and release both protected targets to their objectives.
handoff_requirements: No further positional replacement is planned.
Confirm every roadblock destruction, protected arrival and hostile death independently.
responsibilities: Steward and Lava clear the remaining central runners and armor.
Beagle and Spot retain all surviving central enemies.
Midnight finishes upper-outer enemies and western roadblock #1.
Vanilla finishes the final lower-outer officer.
Both medics retain scheduled boosts until terminal clearance.
battle_phases.start_condition: Steward occupies the upper-central arts tile at 6781.
survival_dependencies: Medical and arts continuity must persist through actual final armor deaths.
The delayed upper civilian must survive until restraint destruction and arrival.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Eastern Steward owns artillery closure. Hibiscus owns his healing; Lava may contribute only when actual acquisition permits. Require death before Steward's withdrawal and survival of pending impacts.
Opening Midnight clears eastern roadblock #3. Returning Midnight clears western #1. Upper interception protects the civilian during both restraint periods; require actual safe arrival.
Opening Melantha clears eastern roadblock #4. Returning Melantha clears western #2. Lower interception protects the civilian; require actual safe arrival.
Fang hands upper-central containment to Beagle. Opening Midnight assists; Lava supplies central arts, followed by returning Steward. Close every runner and armor through actual death.
Vanilla hands lower-central containment to Spot. Lava must clear old pressure before final arrivals exhaust three-block capacity, then finish the final armored queue.
Opening Midnight intercepts early runners and officers; returning Fang bridges final officers; returning Midnight receives the remaining queue and completes western clearance.
Opening Melantha, bridging Vanilla, returning Melantha and final Vanilla provide successive interception. Roadblock destruction and hostile deaths are independently required.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Opening upper-central interception and three automatic DP grants.
Opening lower-central interception and two manual DP grants.
Support Fang, intercept upper-outer enemies and destroy eastern upper roadblock #3.
Intercept opening lower-outer enemies and destroy eastern lower roadblock #4 before withdrawal.
First medical position; cover central blockers, later Hibiscus and Lava.
Permanent lower-central three-block containment using ordinary attacks.
Reciprocal medicine and sole ordinary-range medical coverage of eastern Steward.
Dedicated damage across the eastern artillery circuit.
Bridge the first lower-outer officer pair, then return for the final lower-outer officer.
Persistent single-target arts covering both central blockers and their eastern approaches.
Bridge final upper-outer officers while Midnight redeploys.
Receive Vanilla's lower-outer queue, destroy western lower roadblock #2 and intercept subsequent officers.
Receive Fang's upper-outer queue and destroy western upper roadblock #1.
Permanent upper-central arts after artillery duty and redeployment cooldown.

formation_structure.capacity: At most eight operators are simultaneously deployed. All ten selected IDs are normal-mode rarity-3 catalog operators; no robot deployment-limit exemption is needed.
formation_structure.central: Spot replaces Vanilla at 1651; Beagle replaces Fang at 2072. Lava DOWN at [5,6] covers both blocker tiles. Redeployed Steward supplies additional upper-central arts at 6781. Lava's duty uses single-target damage, without splash credit.

economy.basis: Initial 10 DP and natural 1 DP/s. Credit Fang grants only at 570,1320,2070 and Vanilla grants only at 750,1650.
economy.check: The declared payment ledger remains nonnegative without crediting returning Fang's later automatic grants or final Vanilla's skill income. Minimum declared balance is zero.
economy.conditional_refunds: First Vanilla 5; opening Melantha 7; first Fang 5; first Midnight 8; bridging Vanilla 5; eastern Steward 9; bridging Fang 5; returning Melantha 7.
economy.failure_classification: A missing grant, dead retreat owner or unsuccessful successor deployment is a survival or handoff failure that invalidates dependent funding.
economy.refund_rule: Inspected current runtime returns floor(0.5 * paid deployment cost) only on a successful living retreat.

formation_structure.medical: Ansel DOWN at [5,5] and Hibiscus UP at [2,6] cover each other, both central blockers and Lava. Only Hibiscus covers eastern Steward. Ansel's initial SP permits the first boost near 69 seconds; Hibiscus holds her first boost for the later eastern caster exposure.
formation_structure.opening: Midnight UP at [1,5] covers Fang at [3,5] and roadblock #3 at [1,6]. His damage must shorten the first upper runner's fight sufficiently to replace Lancet's opening survival contribution.
formation_structure.outer: Upper duty passes Midnight to Fang to redeployed Midnight. Lower duty passes opening Melantha to returning Vanilla to returning Melantha to final Vanilla. Western roadblocks deliberately remain separate clearance duties until their assigned returning attackers arrive.
formation_structure.redeployment: Corrected deployment frames leave positive margins over the 2100-frame cooldown for Fang, both Vanilla returns, Melantha, Midnight and Steward.

formation_transitions.transition: Install Midnight's combined upper-outer interception and upper-central support.
Establish Ansel as the first medic.
Replace Vanilla with Spot after the second manual grant.
Withdraw opening Melantha after eastern lower clearance and before further lethal exposure.
Replace Fang with Beagle after the third automatic grant; activate Ansel's first boost.
Complete reciprocal medical coverage with Hibiscus.
Return Vanilla downstream for the first lower-outer officer pair.
Install Lava across both central blockers.
Withdraw Midnight after eastern clearance and both first-pair upper-outer kills.
Install returning Fang upstream of the upper exit and replace lower Vanilla with fresh Melantha.
Withdraw eastern Steward after verified artillery death; existing shells remain relevant.
Replace Fang with returning Midnight on the same upper-outer tile.
Replace Melantha with fresh Vanilla before the final lower-outer officer arrives.
Return Steward to sustained upper-central arts.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Selected IDs and all DEPLOY IDs have union size ten and remain within normal_low_star_catalog with rarity 1-3 and normal_mode true.
Every deployment uses integer [row,col], a declared cardinal direction and compatible terrain. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Midnight must actually damage the first upper runner early enough to preserve Fang through first medical coverage.
Opening income owners survive credited grants. Refund owners survive until successful retreat; no death refund or unsupported income closes a payment gap.
Both medics survive repeated shells and actually heal the required recipients. Range coverage alone does not establish healing delivery.
Midnight's first two later officers must die before 4110. Vanilla must survive to 4173. Fang must survive to 6211. Same-tile replacements execute retreat before deployment at the same frame.
Roadblock #4 must be destroyed before Melantha's 2040 withdrawal; roadblock #3 before Midnight's 4110 withdrawal.
Artillery must die before the fixed 4680 Steward withdrawal. His retreat neither proves death nor cancels existing shells.
Actual deaths must free central block capacity before later runners and armor arrive. One BLOCK event does not close an interception duty.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Destroy all four restraints, prevent civilian deaths and confirm both safe arrivals; waiting at a restraint is not arrival.

Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two expected protected arrivals. Record operator deaths separately; they are not independently forbidden.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Shorten Fang's opening fight, intercept all four lanes, obtain declared grants and establish first healing.
Complete eastern lower clearance, establish both permanent blockers and reciprocal medicine, clear eastern upper restraint, and start dedicated artillery damage.
Establish central arts, close the first upper-outer officer pair, execute both outer bridges and finish artillery without losing medical continuity.
Clear older central pressure before capacity saturates; intercept every final spawn; complete lower western clearance and execute fresh outer replacements.
Finish all armor and runners, destroy the upper western restraint, confirm both protected arrivals and retain the final formation through terminal clearance.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic income; opening ledger credits only grants at 570,1320,2070.
First two activations fund the opening. The final activation accelerates the last lower-outer officer; its income is unnecessary to the ledger.
Boost first lower shell survival, later caster exposure and prolonged central healing. No neutral healing or unsupported extra target is credited.
First boost spans the later eastern Steward and Lava exposure; subsequent boosts sustain final central pressure.
Reduce physical damage during mixed pressure. No reduction of enemy arts is credited.
First arts conversion closes the first upper-outer officer pair before withdrawal. The redeployed activation completes remaining officers and western upper clearance.
Boost returning Melantha against the first two final lower-outer officers.
Accelerate single-target central clearance. First readiness uses the supported deployment SP bonus; later intervals include active duration and full recharge.
Use ordinary arts and the supported automatic attack-SP skill; assume neither talent priority nor arbitrary target selection.
Ordinary blocking and attacks only; no unsupported healing mode or evasion is credited.

tactical_thesis: Use ten operator IDs by combining opening damage, roadblock clearance and later interception duties. Midnight supports Fang from the upper outer lane; Ansel establishes the first medical position. Beagle and Spot replace the opening vanguards, which subsequently bridge outer-lane redeployments. Retain dedicated eastern Steward coverage until artillery death, establish Lava across both central blockers, and return Steward for sustained clearance. This revised structure is unexecuted; the parent's WIN does not validate its new handoffs.
